title: NGS Library Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: KAPA HiFi NGS Library Prep kit

This custom protocol performs part 2 of the [KAPA HiFi NGS Library Prep kit](https://sequencing.roche.com/en/products-solutions/products/sample-preparation/library-amplification/kapa-hifi-kits.html). The protocol can accommodate up to 8 samples. The operator is prompted to perform PCR and normalization off-deck. The number of samples and subsamples should be specified in a .csv file formatted as follows: ``` sample index,# subsamples 1,1 2,2 ``` You can also access a template file [here](https://opentrons-protocol-library-website.s3.amazonaws.com/custom-README-images/69486f/ex.csv). ---
Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Create sample CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file listing each sample index and the number of subsamples (format: `sample index,# subsamples`). Include rows such as `1,1` and `2,2`. The protocol supports up to 8 samples and performs part 2 of the KAPA HiFi NGS Library Prep kit. A template file is available via the provided link.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons protocol interface, input the required protocol parameters as prompted.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the custom labware JSON files (if needed).

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol Python file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App calibration procedure.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the protocol.
